title: V17 maintenance history and inspection policy extract

sections.heading: History
sections.text: The retained work-order register contains no scheduled seat-leakage inspection for V17 in the preceding year. The written practice is replacement when a defect is reported. Two earlier replacements concern V18 and V19, not V17.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This is evidence of the retained maintenance practice and records searched. It is not proof that an inspection would have detected the particular developing V17 condition before the incident, nor evidence that the practice physically created contamination.

sections.heading: Open origin
sections.text: No record dates the onset of the V17 leakage or seat contamination. Budget, training and intent are not documented causes in this extract.
